dedupe_keys.name: great britain energy dashboard historical energy data api

description: Energy Dashboard publishes Great Britain electricity and gas information through a public viewer and a subscription data API. Electricity documentation covers generation by fuel, demand, interconnectors and output from more than 300 individually reported plants. Historical dashboard series extend to 2009, while the availability of each API product differs. Displayed electricity values use gigawatts or gigawatt-hours and are aligned to half-hour periods from source updates at five or thirty minutes. Documented downloads use CSV or JSON and an API key. The viewer is public, but API access requires a paid subscription under custom terms. Internal analysis and derived outputs are permitted within the subscription; redistribution of machine-readable source data requires separate agreement. A limitation is that embedded renewable estimates and generation-based carbon intensity are not direct plant measurements or lifecycle emissions. Simulation uses include calibrating generation mixes, exchange and demand scenarios. No matching catalogue or first-review record was identified. Public documentation and subscription conditions were checked; no account, purchase or API data request was made. It complements data-entsoe-transparency-platform for comparing electricity generation and demand across areas.
